data.name: TotpSeedSummary
data.value: For this item type, Secret is the Base32 TOTP seed. The seed is stored only inside the encrypted vault record. Generated codes are computed locally while unlocked and are not persisted.

data.name: TotpImportSummary
data.value: Paste a bounded otpauth://totp/... URI. The URI contains the seed, is processed locally, is cleared from this editor after import, and must be protected like the seed itself. HOTP is intentionally rejected.

data.name: TotpImportSemanticDescription
data.value: Sensitive TOTP setup URI to import locally

data.name: TotpCopySetupUriSemanticDescription
data.value: Copy a TOTP setup URI containing this encrypted seed using timed clipboard cleanup

data.name: TotpCopyCodeSemanticDescription
data.value: Copy the current one-time password temporarily

data.name: TotpSafetyWarning
data.value: Only import TOTP seeds you are authorized to use. Copying a seed, setup URI, or generated code can expose it through operating-system clipboard history or synchronization; CipherNest applies the same best-effort timed clipboard cleanup policy used for other secrets.
